coverage.notes: This case validates opening the add-app flow, saving a new app, and confirming it appears in the apps list.

preconditions: The standard E2E user exists and can sign in.
The local frontend and backend E2E servers are reachable.
At least one additional app can be created for the signed-in account.
A unique app name is available for the current run.
assertions: The user can open the new app registration flow from the apps page.
Required fields can be filled and submitted successfully.
The created app becomes visible in the apps list after save.
notes: Keeps app creation verification isolated from edit/delete and downstream history/stats flows, while cleanup removes the created app after the assertion step.
